## Context

A legal review (UrhG § 4 `Sammelwerk`/`Datenbankwerk`) found that storing a source
compilation's selection and arrangement on server-held data is prohibited. This REQ drops
the `lektion`/`sequence` fields REQ-018 added, privatises structure tags, and reduces the
shipped corpus to words only.

## Requirement

Remove Lektion/sequence from server-held data; ship a words-only corpus and importer.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] The `lektion` and `sequence` fields are removed from `Vocab`; a migration drops them
      and the partial unique constraint. *Migration test `test_drop_lektion_sequence`.*
- [x] The shipped `latin_corpus.json` carries only intrinsic word data — no selection or
      arrangement. *Corpus test `test_corpus_is_words_only`.*
- [x] Grouping and ordering live only on a teacher's own private tags, never on the `Vocab`
      row or the shared pool.

## Notes

- This reverses REQ-018 in full; it is recorded as `supersedes: [REQ-018]`.
